name: clipplay-desktop
description: Cross-platform desktop client for ClipPlay - The Ultimate Video & Audio Downloader
author: ClipPlay Team <support@clipplay.video>

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder
scripts.build:mac: tsc && vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: tsc && vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win
scripts.build:linux: tsc && vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --linux
